matching_scope: One minimum-cost permutation of active whole-sheet spectra per case, shared by all 14 windows; inactive padding remains fixed.
prelaunch_identifiability_addendum: Parent-requested discrete-label review before any fresh concept_3 launch. V2.1 removes ordering as a grading convention; physical features, labels, resolution, noise, mass scales, and pass thresholds are unchanged.
target: 14 normalized spectral-window masses for each active sheet, padded to 3 sheets
public_structural_feature: sheet_count only; no gap, mixture weight, family, or generating parameters
scoring_average: mean squared normalized error over active sheets and 14 windows, then square root per case
prelaunch_provenance: User-authorized v1 rejection and bounded v2 calibration; v1 archived under adversary/prelaunch_v1; mass scales and pass thresholds unchanged
change_policy: Frozen after explicitly authorized pre-tournament calibration and before any fresh scientific attempt; no subsequent changes to target, distribution, hidden selection, scales, or pass thresholds.
